name: Four-colour primer readout
summary: Smith, Hood and colleagues labelled sequencing primers with four coloured dyes so all four reactions could run in one gel lane and be read by computer, automating DNA sequencing.
description: Smith and colleagues tagged primers with four fluorophores, combined reaction products in one gel tube and acquired detected bands by computer.
tier_reason: A major reusable result, process or system within its field; broader multi-field or multi-generation dependence on this exact referent is not established.

impact.note: First turned DNA sequencing into a machine-read, computer-called activity for one profession, and automated sequencers and genome production grew from it.
